text:
Priya S.: Quick sync — HelixHealth private VPC cutover scheduled Thu. Need owners confirmed for: firewall/egress, signed artifact handoff (air-gap), and onprem deploy PR review. Who's taking what?

Leo M.: I can own firewall/egress. NetOps still needs the final customer IP set (they gave a partial list). Pinged @NetOps.

Yun K.: I'll handle the signed artifacts. Small snag: artifact signer key rotated in staging last week, so packer artifacts currently fail signature checks. I have a branch that updates the signer config, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onprem-deploy/pull/482 — needs 1 reviewer.

Dan O.: On call for PR reviews. I'll take a look at #482 now. If you can drop the minimal config diff here I can speed-review.

Yun K.: Thanks — diff snippet:
```
- SIGNER_ENDPOINT=https://signer.internal:8443
+ SIGNER_ENDPOINT=https://signer.internal:9443
+ SIGNER_KEY_ID=svc-signer-helix
```
Also changed packer job to use `--no-cache` for reproducibility.

Dan O.: Ok left two comments about error handling and a small lint. If CI passes and I don't see regressions I'll merge. ETA ~30m.

Priya S.: Timeline note: if PR merged by EOD (today) we can run a packaging job tonight and drop signed tar to the customer's SFTP during the offline window. Otherwise canary slips to Monday.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved for HelixHealth on Fri 09:00 UTC (ID: canary-helix-202). Please ensure preflight checks complete.

NetOps Bot: Customer provided IPs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.5/32. Please confirm NAT mapping and firewall ACLs.

Leo M.: Confirmed, will add rules to staging and prod as soon as NetOps confirms NAT mapping. Filing CR-3812 to track the change.

Yun K.: Also need an approval on the onprem service account (svc-infer-deploy) for the artifact pull role. Dan, can you approve the IAM change in CR-3812?

Dan O.: I can approve once the PR merges, but please add an audit note explaining why we need the broader pull scope.

Priya S.: Air-gap handoff detail: customer requested SHA-signed tar by Thu 18:00 PST. Do we have a secure window?

Leo M.: We have a scheduled offline window 18:30-19:30 PST. If Yun can produce artifacts by 17:30 we can do transfer and verification in that window.

Yun K.: I'll kick packer at 17:30 and upload to the secure SFTP. Adding a note to ticket TICK-2245 with expected filenames and SHAs.

Priya S.: Nice. Final call for blockers or prereqs (eg: cert rotation, proxy egress, CR approvals). Code-review ping to @Dan O and @Leo M. :eyes:

Dan O.: Merging in 10m, will comment on CR-3812 with audit justification after merge.

deploy-bot: PR merged (onprem-deploy#482). CI passed. Canary deploy queued (canary-helix-202).

Priya S.: Thanks everyone — updating the cutover runbook and tagging owners. I'll follow up with a short post-mortem checklist after canary completes. :thumbsup:
